summary.text: Tell the medical institution you want to claim and use MediSave. Complete the form they provide.

details.heading: Estimate your claim
details.body: Use the MediSave and MediShield Life claims calculator to estimate how much you can withdraw from MediSave and or claim from MediShield Life.

steps.name: Tell the institution
steps.text: Inform the participating medical institution that you want to claim from MediShield Life or your Integrated Shield Plan, and use your MediSave to pay for your medical expenses.

steps.name: Complete the form
steps.text: Complete the Medical Claims Authorisation Form provided by the medical institution.

steps.name: Let them submit the claim
steps.text: The completed form authorises the medical institution to check how much you can use from your healthcare plans and submit the medical claim for you.

How do I claim from MediShield Life or an Integrated Shield Plan?
How can I use MediSave for my medical expenses?
How do I claim medical expenses using MediShield Life and MediSave?

sources.page_title: How do I claim from MediShield Life / Integrated Shield Plan (IP) and MediSave for my medical expenses?

quotes.text: You may inform the participating medical institution(s) that you wish to make a claim from your MediShield Life or Integrated Shield Plan and use your MediSave to pay for your medical expenses.
The medical institution will provide you with a copy of the Medical Claims Authorisation Form to complete.
It authorises them to check how much you can utilise from your healthcare plans and submit the medical claim on your behalf.
You may use the MediSave and MediShield Life claims calculator to estimate how much you can withdraw from your MediSave and / or claim from MediShield Life.
